description: Get everything needed to decide on one application to your bounty, in one call: the listing (title, description, requirements, completion criteria, skills, pay, location rules, screening settings, and seats filled/open), the applicant's profile (display name, bio, skills, expertise, declared city and country, verified badge, rating, review count, completed jobs), the application (cover letter, availability, screening answers with uploaded files as owner-only download paths, submitted links, mic check, language result), and the outcome so far (status, whether AI screening flagged it for your manual review, and the applicant-facing reason). This is the same applicant information AI screening reads. Decide with accept_application or reject_application. Owner only.
